# In need of some [[rest]] or [[sleep]].
#: {{syn|en|jaded}}
#: {{syn|en|exhausted|fatigued|languid|Thesaurus:fatigued|Thesaurus:sleepy}}
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=1964
|author=w:John F. Kennedy
|chapter=Where We Stand
|title=w:A Nation of Immigrants
|url=https://archive.org/details/nationofimmigran0000kenn/
|edition=Revised and Enlarged
|publisher=w:Harper & Row
|LCCN=64-7830
|OCLC=899031989
|page=77
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/nationofimmigran0000kenn/page/77/
|text=The famous words of Emma Lazarus on the pedestal of the Statue of Liberty read: “Give me your '''tired''', your poor, your huddled masses yearning to breathe free.” Until 1921 this was an accurate picture of our society. Under present law it would be appropriate to add: “as long as they come from Northern Europe, are not too '''tired''' or too poor or slightly ill, never stole a loaf of bread, never joined any questionable organization, and can document their activities for the past two years.”}}
# [[fed up|Fed up]], [[annoyed]], [[irritated]], sick of.
#: {{syn|en|frustrated|sick and tired|weary|Thesaurus:annoyed}}
#: {{ux|en|I'm '''tired''' of this}}
# [[overused|Overused]], [[cliché]].
#: {{syn|en|banal|played out|trite|Thesaurus:hackneyed}}
#: {{ux|en|a '''tired''' song}}
# Old and worn.
#: {{syn|en|outworn|shabby|worn-out|Thesaurus:deteriorated}}
#: {{ux|en|a '''tired'''-looking hotel room}}
# {{lb|en|slang|AAVE|pejorative}} [[played out|Played out]], [[ineffectual]]; [[incompetent]].
#: {{syn|en|fruitless|inane|useless|Thesaurus:futile}}

#* {{quote-book|en|year=2023|title=The Crow Cries at Midnight. Dorked|chapter=Chapter 10: Your Priestess is in Another Castle|publisher={{w|Persona (series)|''Persona'' fandom}}|url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/48777436/chapters/128022967|passage=A '''tired''' attempt at a smile worked its way across Akechi's lips, lopsided and faint.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250707110902/https://archiveofourown.org/works/48777436/chapters/128022967|archivedate=7 July 2025}}
